about_the_game:
I Made This Game in 1 Year
A fast-paced roguelike focused on deep meta progression, intense combat, and high replayability.

Choose your class:

  • 🛡️ Warrior – up-close and personal with heavy weapons

  • 🔮 Mage – ranged spellcaster with powerful elemental attacks

  • 🧠 Mentalist – manipulates enemies with psychic abilities

Key Features:

  • 🏙️ Main City Hub – unlock permanent upgrades, gear, and skill enhancements

  • ⛏️ Mining Mode – gather resources to craft and upgrade your equipment

  • ⚔️ Fighting Mode – battle through endless waves of monsters with increasing difficulty

  • 📈 Meta Progression – improve your characters permanently across all runs

  • 🧪 Build Variety – dozens of skills and upgrades to customize your playstyle

  • 👹 Enemy Variety – tons of monsters, unique spawn patterns, and challenging boss fights

  • 🔁 High Replayability – each run feels fresh with randomized elements and evolving difficulty

Whether you're grinding for resources, theorycrafting the perfect build, or just trying to survive one more wave — I Made This Game in 1 Year rewards your time and keeps the challenge coming.

Credits:

Teaser Music: #Uppbeat (free for Creators!)

Store Assets: lui.gg
